critical_code_review_comments: _link_signature_everywhere builds the SAME mongo query in both branches of the ternary (if not qp: ... else: ...) — the else branch never differentiates on qp_code, so batches with a distinct qp match by name only. Low-impact for current data but the ternary is dead code; either drop it or actually gate on qp_code (job_role field isn't stored on batches with qp, so behaviour is functionally correct but confusing).
server.py continues to exceed 24k lines. Repeated flag from prior iterations — modularise course-master/migration/rate-config into their own routers.

In _resolve_course_masters, admin path does NOT stamp course_master_version on rows that DON'T have a course_master_id (fine), but if admin unsets a master link (course_master_id=None) on an existing WO row, the previously-stamped course_master_version is not cleared. Not blocking but worth clearing in the else branch.
